text:
support-jen: Heads up — ACME is seeing repeated 502/504s on hosted inference since ~11:02 UTC. Ticket #SUP-8423. Customer reports timeouts on longseq requests (seq len ~6k) and intermittent 5xxs.

ops-bot: ALERT: prod-us-east-1 gateway: queue_depth=1832 (limit=2048), dequeue_p95=8.9s, batcher_backlog=74s. alert_id INC-2026-391.

olivia: I'm on it. Is this focused to one tenant or system-wide?

support-jen: Primarily acme-tenant but saw p95 bumps for other longseq heavy tenants too.

raj: Looking at batcher logs — continuous-batcher showing many enqueues waiting >> 5s. I can repro locally by firing a flood of longseq requests.

sasha: Any sign of KV cache spinup? If kvcache miss rate spiked, tails cascade.

raj: Snippet from batcher logs:
```
2026-03-18T11:02:12Z INFO enqueue id=rq_8f7a3 enqueue_wait=5020ms kvcache_hit=false model=redwood-3b quant=8bit
2026-03-18T11:02:13Z WARN dequeue_worker_pool=full pending_batches=47
2026-03-18T11:02:14Z ERROR request_timeout id=rq_8f7a4 elapsed=12000ms
```

olivia: Quick mitigation proposal: lower max_queue_depth for acme to 512 and enable immediate shedding for extreme longseq while we stabilize. Also consider routing heavy requests to smaller model variant for now.

raj: I can push a temporary config override: `/infractl set tenant acme --max_queue=512 --shed_policy=immediate --reason "mitigate tailtimeouts"`

sasha: Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/queue-saturation — steps 1-3 (patch tenant caps, scale batchers, monitor).

ops-bot: runbook task started by olivia. oncall: @raj, @sasha. ETA 5m.

raj: Patched acme override and scaled batcher replicas +2 in prod-us-east-1. Command used: `kubectl scale deployment/batcher-prod-us-east -n inference --replicas=12`

support-jen: Customer reports errors reduced around 11:11 UTC but getting occasional 504s still.

olivia: Monitoring now: queue_depth=420, dequeue_p95=1.3s, batcher_backlog=6s. Improving but keep watch for KV miss churn.

raj: Root cause hypothesis: a bulk ingest job from the tenant pushed many long sequences concurrently, causing KV cache churn and long enqueue waits. Also saw thinpool network backlog spike which amplified dequeue delays.

sasha: Collected sample request ids rq_8f7a3 and rq_8f7a4; traces uploaded to s3: s3://r-infra/trace/1729100000/ (includes batcher traces + gateway headers).

olivia: Immediate follow-ups:
- tighten tenant admission for longseqs (per-tenant max_queue default -> 256)
- add circuit-breaker on kvcache spinup (reject after 1s of spin attempts)
- alerting change: fire when dequeue_p95>3s AND kv_miss_rate>0.25 to avoid noisy p95-only alerts
- write a runbook addendum for longseq-heavy tenants

support-jen: I'll update SUP-8423 with mitigation steps and offer prioritized support window if ACME needs guaranteed throughput while they rework their ingest.

ops-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED — metrics stable for 10m. Incident duration ~9m. tags: [hosted, queue-saturation, tail-latency].

olivia: :white_check_mark: closing here. We'll schedule a short postmortem and a config rollout for tightened tenant caps. Thanks all.
